files.html:
0.1.4. Changelog

Fixes

  • Fixed NPC gun damage calculation when Pillager’s Gun is installed.
  • Fixed animation errors when NPCs attack with an empty hand.
  • Fixed several NPC firearm and combat animation playback issues.
  • Fixed NPCs freezing in mid-air while reloading after knockback or while in water.

Added / Improved

  • Improved GUI readability, layout, and overall usability.
  • Added item rendering for grenade selection.
  • Added Advanced Stance rules, allowing NPC combat behavior to change based on health, target faction, target tags, and target entity IDs.
  • Added multi-select support for Advanced target factions, tags, and entity IDs.
  • Added default/general fallback behavior for Advanced Stance mode.
  • Added empty-hand attack animation support.
  • Added configurable NPC default movement speed.
  • Added stored weapon removal controls for gun and melee weapon settings.
  • Added Chinese and Japanese language support.
